data.revised_prompt:
Create a 1536x1024 2D chibi game sprite sheet for an office simulation UI on a perfectly flat solid chroma-key background color #00ff00, with no texture, no shadow, no gradient, no floor plane, no extra objects, no text. Arrange as a precise 6 columns x 4 rows grid, each cell exactly 256x256 px, with the full character centered in each cell and generous padding. Use a polished anime-adjacent Q-version chibi style with clean dark outlines, soft cel shading, rounded simplified hands and feet, cute but professional office-agent look, matching a modern office-agent talk/work sprite-sheet visual language.

Row 1: male ACEHarness office agent walking to screen-right, 6 loopable keyframes. Row 2: same male walking to screen-left, 6 loopable keyframes. Row 3: female ACEHarness office agent walking to screen-right, 6 loopable keyframes. Row 4: same female walking to screen-left, 6 loopable keyframes.

Mandatory proportions: each character 2.1 to 2.4 heads tall total, with the head taking about 40–45% of total height. Very short compact body and legs, no long realistic legs, no tall adult proportions.

Male: oversized round chibi head, short dark hair, navy blazer, white shirt, dark pants, black shoes. Female: oversized round chibi head, brown ponytail, navy blazer, white blouse, black skirt, black shoes. Both are modern professional AI office teammates.

Animation requirements for every row: Column 1 contact pose with one short leg forward and the other back, opposite arm forward. Column 2 down pose with body slightly lower, front knee bent, rear foot lifting. Column 3 passing pose with one knee lifted under the body, arms near center. Column 4 high point pose with body slightly higher, opposite knee forward. Column 5 opposite contact pose with legs and arms reversed from column 1. Column 6 recovery pose visibly different and ready to loop back to column 1. Arms swing opposite to legs. Hair and blazer may bounce slightly. Make each of the 6 frames obviously different and clearly animated, not repeated standing poses.

Keep character scale, lighting, head size, and camera angle stable across all frames. Feet must be visible and aligned to the same baseline in every frame. Side-view walking pose only. Cute game sprite cycle feel, not realistic motion. Do not use #00ff00 anywhere in the characters. No frame labels, no grid lines, no watermark, no extra people, no desks, no chairs, no speech bubbles, no cropped feet, no inconsistent identity, no sliding feet, no static pose, no photorealism, no 3D render, no runway proportions.
